string.text: A rugged chest-mounted body camera with a wide-angle lens, a time-stamped overlay and a friend-or-foe tag display. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.\n\nRuns on a standard battery: drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.
How long a full battery lasts while the camera records, in real-time hours. Scaled by the difficulty's battery consumption setting.
